title: viola aethnensis subsp. calabra
intro: Viola aethnensis subsp. calabra, commonly known as the Etna violet, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Violaceae, native to Sicily. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, with its health benefits including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Viola aethnensis subsp. calabra include its ability to calm and soothe the digestive system, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
